cases.name: Diane Kimar-Luman
cases.about: She taught at Cedar Crest Elementary in Greenville — mostly third grade — for more than 30 years, her friend Deb Petersen told News 8. Petersen said Kimar-Luman was a “wonderful, well-loved teacher and co-worker.” “Even when times were tough for her, she would say something to make us laugh,” Petersen said. “We shared a close-knit group of friends who taught together in Greenville for over 30 years. We laughed and cried together and raised our kids together. After retiring, we traveled and continued to spend time making memories,” Petersen said. “She (was) a truly good person to everyone who knew and loved her. One in a million.” Petersen said Kimar-Luman was a “wonderful mom” who always put her children first and “pretty much raised them by herself.”
